note: Exact-text hooks for the integrator. Each find text appears exactly once in its file. tests/web/crm_loyalty_test.js applies every hook to a scratch copy of the file, parses it, serves the copies and runs the screens and the till flow on them. The real files are not edited by package CRM-F.

hooks.why: Lets the coupon box read the cart and fill the normal discount box. Without it the coupon box does nothing (BOS.pos.ctx is missing) and the POS works exactly as today.
hooks.replace: B.pos = { flush, normMobile, ctx: () => ({ loc: P.loc, lines: linesOf(), sub: cartSub(), customerId: (P.cust.info && P.cust.info.id) || null, setDiscount: (v) => { P.dk = 'amount'; const i = $('#cart_disc'); if (i) i.value = String(v); discChanged(); drawDisc(); } }) };   // bosCRMF

hooks.why: Draws the coupon box in the cart sheet (only when coupons are ON and the person may sell). Without it there is no coupon box.
